description: Test suite for AVC (H.264) parameter set conversion functions, including Annex B to AVCC format conversions and validation of parameter set parsing.

methods.name: ToAnnexB
methods.description: Converts a NALU body to Annex B format with start code prefix.

methods.name: ToAvcc
methods.description: Converts a NALU body to AVCC format with size prefix.

methods.name: ConvertAnnexBToAvcc
methods.description: Converts a vector of Annex B formatted NALUs to AVCC format.

methods.name: VerifyConvertTo
methods.description: Verifies conversion of parameter sets to headless format and consistency.

methods.name: VerifyAnnexB
methods.description: Verifies correctness of parsed parameter sets from Annex B data.

methods.name: VerifyAllEmpty
methods.description: Checks behavior with empty or invalid NALUs.

methods.name: HasEqualParameterSets
methods.description: Checks equality of two parameter set vectors.
